subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should provider-native search automatically become the default for all Copilot `gpt-*`, `chatgpt-*`, and `o*` Responses models whenever web search is enabled and no managed provider is pinned?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but source metadata does not expose a web-search capability bit, so the broad automatic eligibility and resulting behavior change require maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Approve after capability proof
options.body: Keep the proposed default after live evidence demonstrates representative eligible model families and documents unsupported exceptions.

options.title: Narrow the eligibility boundary
options.body: Enable native search only for an explicit proven model set or a future Copilot capability signal.

options.title: Keep managed search by default
options.body: Do not auto-enable hosted Copilot search until an explicit product/config direction is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve after capability proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed default after live evidence demonstrates representative eligible model families and documents unsupported exceptions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to Copilot routing and provider SDK boundaries, making them the strongest available owner for the default-routing decision.
